t: Wild Frank in Australia: Marsupial Encounters
d: Frank is in the Australian jungle with the Wombat. A marsupial that resembles a giant hamster and can weigh up to 26 kilos. Frank approaches stealthily, as it is a very elusive animal and can reach 40 km / h.

t: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
d: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property  plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

The zoo's medical team must perform critical surgery on a bison calf born with a bowed leg  three lynx kittens are ready to explore their exhibit  the first known U.S. case of COVID-19 in animals is confirmed when a Malayan tiger tests positive.

A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness  single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

t: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
d: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat  Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

t: Dogs: The Untold Story: Survival of the Friendliest
d: A look at how dogs have evolved from wild predators to friendly pets  features parts of the world where dogs are spoiled as much as children.
